title: Add human verification gate to ticket-do command
story: As a developer, I want the ticket-do command to pause and ask me to verify before closing a ticket when automated tests are insufficient, so that tickets are never closed without appropriate sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: ticket-do explicitly distinguishes between tickets that can be closed on passing tests alone and those requiring human verification
When human verification is required, the agent presents testing instructions directly in chat and waits for user confirmation before closing
The agent never leaves testing instructions in code, story files, or comments

title: Add plan re-confirmation step on plan changes in ticket-do
story: As a developer, I want the agent to re-confirm the updated plan with me whenever the plan changes mid-execution, so that I always have visibility and approval before implementation continues.
acceptance_criteria: ticket-do instructs the agent to re-present the full updated plan whenever a change is made mid-execution
The agent waits for explicit user confirmation before continuing after a plan change
The re-confirmation step is identical in form to the initial plan confirmation step

title: Add closed ticket status and close-ticket command
story: As a developer, I want to close a ticket without completing programming work, so that I can track intentional decisions to skip or abandon a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: A 'closed' status is a valid terminal status alongside 'done'
A close-ticket command exists that sets a ticket's status to 'closed' and prompts the user for an optional reason
Closed tickets are treated as terminal — they are not pulled into future sprints
sprint-close and retro commands handle closed tickets appropriately

title: Replace LLM-driven verbatim field entry in ticket-do with explicit instruction
story: As a developer, I want verbatim text I provide to be placed into ticket fields exactly as given, without the agent interpreting or acting on it, so that data entry is reliable.
acceptance_criteria: ticket-do explicitly instructs the agent to treat user-provided verbatim text as inert data to be transcribed, not as instructions to act on
The agent asks for confirmation before taking any action when the user is in the middle of providing field values

title: Snapshot tests for all Storybook stories
story: As a developer, I want automatic snapshot tests for every Storybook story so that I can refactor code without worrying that I've changed what actually gets rendered.
acceptance_criteria: Every existing Storybook story has a corresponding snapshot test
Every new Storybook story must have a corresponding snapshot test
Snapshot tests capture the rendered DOM tree
Failing snapshot tests block the build
Developers can regenerate snapshots using an existing command when rendering changes are intentional

title: Validate API key on exercise start
story: As a user, I want my API key validated when I press Start Exercise so that I don't waste time completing an exercise only to discover the key is invalid.

title: Local script to retrieve next ticket number
story: As a developer, I want a local script that retrieves the next ticket number so that I don't contribute towards LLM API usage limits.

title: Script to record user retro feedback verbatim
story: As a developer, I want a script to record my retro feedback directly into the ticket JSON so that the LLM cannot interpret or act on it.
acceptance_criteria: A script exists that accepts a ticket ID and prompts for user_retro text via stdin
The script writes the input verbatim to the user_retro field of the matching ticket in current-sprint.json
The retro command instructs the agent to invoke this script for collecting user_retro rather than asking in chat

title: New story stub script
story: As a developer, I want a script that creates a stub story ticket so that I can quickly capture an idea without going through the full grooming process.
acceptance_criteria: Script accepts a title/one-liner as a command-line argument
Script appends a new ticket to the backlog with the provided title and empty fields matching the existing ticket JSON format
Script uses next-ticket-id.py to determine and increment the ticket ID
Script exits with code 0 on success and nonzero on error
